NWD wszystkich liczb z wejścia
templates.solve:
ll x, g = 0; bool any = false; while (cin >> x) { g = __gcd(g, llabs(x)); any = true; }
if (!any || g == 0) cout << "{{NONE}}" << "\n"; else cout << g << "\n";

templates.name: NWW wielu liczb
Czy liczba jest pierwsza
Pierwszość wielu liczb
templates.solve:
ll n; cin >> n;
for (ll i = 0; i < n; i++) { ll x; cin >> x; bool p = x >= 2; for (ll d = 2; d * d <= x && p; d++) if (x % d == 0) p = false; cout << (p ? "{{YES}}" : "{{NO}}") << "\n"; }

templates.name: Rozkład wielu liczb na czynniki
templates.solve:
ll n; cin >> n;
for (ll i = 0; i < n; i++) { ll x; cin >> x; bool first = true; for (ll d = 2; d * d <= x; d++) while (x % d == 0) { cout << (first ? "" : " ") << d; first = false; x /= d; } if (x > 1) cout << (first ? "" : " ") << x; cout << "\n"; }

variants.name: Rozkład wielu liczb (a*b)
variants.solve:
ll n; cin >> n;
for (ll i = 0; i < n; i++) { ll x; cin >> x; bool first = true; for (ll d = 2; d * d <= x; d++) while (x % d == 0) { cout << (first ? "" : "*") << d; first = false; x /= d; } if (x > 1) cout << (first ? "" : "*") << x; cout << "\n"; }
